sub: Every word of this website and of the Jutyar app, in Kurdish and English. Write them in clear, simple language that farmers and staff use every day.
sheet_note: The main way to write the Kurdish is the spreadsheet on your Desktop: Jutyar_Translation/jutyar_texts.xlsx (one row per text, with English next to it). It is loaded into the site with one command. Small fixes can be made here too: a text changed here wins over the spreadsheet.
search: Search a key or a text
reset: Back to the text in the file
reset_done: Back to the text in the file
blur_saves: A text is saved when you leave its box
checked_long: A native Kurdish speaker read this text and it is clear.
app_sub: Texts the Jutyar app shows farmers. The app reads them from the backend once it is connected.
key_bad: Use small letters, numbers and _ with a dot between parts, like home.title.
del_text: The app will no longer find the text {key}. Only delete it if the app does not use it any more.
